content.short: Scallop is the primary peer-to-peer money market on Sui, offering high-yield lending and professional DeFi tools.
content.description: Scallop is the leading decentralized money market and liquidity protocol built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide a professional-grade borrowing and lending experience. As the first DeFi project officially funded by the Sui Foundation, the platform focuses on institutional-grade security and maximum capital efficiency. Users can supply digital assets to earn interest or borrow against them with sub-second finality. Powered by the $SCA token, Scallop features robust governance and innovative tools like the Scallop SDK, serving as a vital liquidity hub for the Sui ecosystem.
content.meta: Scallop provides professional-grade lending and borrowing tools on the Sui blockchain. Discover Scallop and more DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
